title: Local finite presentation of a morphism over a base
statement: Let $S,X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with structure morphisms $p:X\to S$ and $q:Y\to S$. Suppose $p$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and $q$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For every morphism $h:X\to Y$ with $q\circ h=p$, the morphism $h$ is locally of finite presentation and hence locally of finite type. The same conclusions hold for $h|_U:U\to Y$ for every open subscheme $U\subseteq X$.
